items.title: Russian bombing kills 26 people at Ukraine aid centre, Kyiv says
items.description: Local officials say more had been missing after at least nine 3,000kg aerial bombs hit a village in southern Ukraine.

items.title: Copilot in deadly Florida jet crash identified in reports as 20-year-old
items.description: In air traffic audio, a crew member can be heard shouting: "We are going to crash into the ground!"

items.title: Shop freezers in seven European countries hit by cyber-attack
items.description: The temperature of freezers in several shops across Europe reportedly rose to as high as 50C.

items.title: Fighting returns to Kherson region after longest Ukraine war ceasefire
items.description: Though unprecedented, the six-day truce has done little to alter the wider trajectory of a war that continues to grinds on.

items.title: Man guilty of stealing cash from farm owned by South African president
items.description: The case, part of the "Farmgate" scandal, has left President Cyril Ramaphosa mired in an impeachment saga.

items.title: Dutch police offer record €2m reward in hunt for drug lord
items.description: Jos Leijdekkers has been found guilty in absentia of cocaine smuggling and is believed to be in Sierra Leone.

items.title: Trump to remove Rwanda and South Africa from US trade deal
items.description: The move comes barely a week after Rwanda's defence ministry was hit with sanctions by the US Treasury.
